title: Enrolment in Government Schools by District
description: Number of students enrolled in primary, secondary, and post-secondary government schools at national, state, and district level.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia for national-level data

fields.name: district
fields.title: District
fields.description: [Categorical] One of the administrative districts, or 'All Districts' for state-level data

fields.name: stage
fields.title: School Stage
fields.description: [Categorical] Either primary (Standards 1 to 6), secondary (Form 1 to 5), or post-secondary education (Form 6)

fields.name: sex
fields.title: Sex
fields.description: [Categorical] Either both sexes, male, or female

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from individual-level administrative records maintained by the Ministry of Education Malaysia via the Education Management Information System (EMIS).
